title: Contract interruption and provider persistence confirmation
assumptions: Recovery and provider evidence changes preserve every existing contract price, payout formula, quantity cap and budget.
Interrupted item escrow and definite payment rejection become visible manual reviews; no automatic payout or refund is introduced.
A successful payment requires Redis-visible balance confirmation, not only the RedisEconomy local cache. An unconfirmed provider call is never repeated.
The zero deltas below describe unchanged planned currency flows, not an estimate of historical lost or delayed payments.
Held items and quota remain obligations until an evidence-backed resolution. They are not income or newly minted currency.
